SELECT A.CUT_ID ,A.CUT_NM ,A.MBL_PHN_NO ,A.EMAIL ,A.DONG ,A.HO ,A.CX_ID ,CX.CX_NM ,A.REG_DT ,A.REG_ID ,A.UPD_DT ,A.UPD_ID FROM TB_CUCU001 A INNER JOIN TB_CUCU002 B ON A.CUT_ID = B.CUT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_ORCX001 CX ON A.CX_ID = CX.CX_ID WHERE B.CUT_CRD_NO = #{customerCardNo}

SELECT A.CUT_ID ,A.CUT_NM ,A.MBL_PHN_NO ,A.EMAIL ,A.DONG ,A.HO ,A.CX_ID ,CX.CX_NM ,A.REG_DT ,A.REG_ID ,A.UPD_DT ,A.UPD_ID FROM TB_CUCU001 A LEFT JOIN TB_ORCX001 CX ON A.CX_ID = CX.CX_ID WHERE A.CUT_ID = #{customerId}

SELECT COUNT(A.CUT_ID) FROM TB_CUCU001 A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CUCU002 B ON B.CUT_CRD_NO = ( SELECT X.CUT_CRD_NO FROM TB_CUCU002 X WHERE X.CUT_ID = A.CUT_ID ORDER BY X.STOP_YN ASC, X.REG_DT DESC LIMIT 1 )
